name: Overqwil
flavorText: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
description: Overqwil is the Pin Cluster Pokémon, a Dark- and Poison-type first discovered in the Hisui region. It stands 8'02" (2.5 m) tall and weighs 133.4 lbs (60.5 kg). Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
